Bhāgacandra
alias Bhāgacandragaṇi alias Bhāgendu, teacher of Sadānandagaṇijit (a. of C. Subodhinī on Siddhāntacandrikā of Rāmacandrāśrama, C.. VIII. 121).
-Mahāvīrāṣṭaka. Jhalrapatan p. 124. Rajasthan Jain Pt. IV. p.. 413. 426 (in a. collection).
Pt.. Sadgrantharatnākara Kāryālaya, 1919. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1531.
-C. Siddhāntaratnamālāvacanikā on Ṣaṣṭhiśatakaprakaraṇa of Nemīcandrabhaṇḍāri. RORI. XVIII. 1914. Extr. p.. 504-08.
